paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar cooling bound from R2 parameter (AGB/HB ratio) in globular clusters using MESA simulations. Most conservative constraint g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 (semiconvection scheme). Mass-independent bound valid for ALP masses between O(10^-6) and O(1) eV, encoded as horizontal line. Asteroseismology-supported improved bound would be 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 (predictive mixing), which is a projection not adopted as the main result. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
